question: Should the five-stage receipt-bound repair pipeline at head e48cc615899e7ad1ee130a1f9891368e8ce0ec6d replace the current production mutation path after its exact-head canary passes?
rationale: The PR intentionally changes authorization authority, credential scope, validation provenance, publication identity, recovery semantics, and fail-closed behavior; automated tests cannot decide whether maintainers accept that production trust and availability boundary.

options.title: Canary Then Adopt
options.body: Run the complete production-equivalent flow on the final head and merge if exact publication, strict rulesets, reruns, and recovery all pass.

options.title: Split The Rollout
options.body: Land staged proof planning separately and defer privileged publication and lifecycle recovery to a narrower follow-up.

options.title: Retain Current Pipeline
options.body: Pause the redesign if its operational complexity or intentional fail-closed availability cost is not acceptable.

recommendation.title: Canary Then Adopt
recommendation.body: Run the complete production-equivalent flow on the final head and merge if exact publication, strict rulesets, reruns, and recovery all pass.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent introduced the current validation path and owns this redesign, making him the strongest available owner to lead the exact-head canary and frame the boundary decision.
